question: Can the original terminal utility train a transferable closed-loop recruit policy directly, with a whole-game paired return signal and temporally coherent exploration?
model: Freeze v1.4-r1. Zero-initialized 24-coefficient adjustment of legal action logits on T7-12. Public health, gold, tier timing, board/hand occupancy, tribe support, duplicates, current stat share, and whether a board entity was present at turn start. Per-action adjustment clipped to +/-3. Original policy everywhere else.
training: Two independent seeds 134171 and 134189. Eight fixed updates each, 12 orthogonal parameter directions, eight paired fresh v14 natural seeds per direction, 1536 whole games per seed. Antithetic perturbations +/-0.6 times each direction, original final rank utility difference, Adam ascent 0.18, betas .9/.99, parameter decay .99 and bounds +/-1.5. No elite selection or endpoint selection.
controls: Native 245 guarded actions and standard v14 seven-seat snapshot opponents; no expert targets, forced upgrades, curriculum resets, rollout search or extra shaped reward. Policies operate on newly observed legal shops; fresh seed blocks across updates. No formal long training.
assessment: Both fixed policies and the unmodified parent on 256 common fresh natural v14hold seeds 83500000..83500255. Log activity and all ranks, common T9-T12 growth, reach, per-turn P50 and count. Only if all five existing D-128 compute criteria hold here, independently replicate on a separate 512-seed natural panel. Otherwise stop this method.
